summary: First test iteration for ÉxamSécure. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests PASS covering auth (login, register, me, cookies, bad creds), exam CRUD, seeded exams presence (FRA401/HIS301/MAT402), student join (invalid/draft/empty name/open/rejoin), student session, save answers, event counting + locking after 3 tab_hidden, uncounted events, submit + rejoin block, teacher sessions + unlock + grading, file upload (invalid format rejection + PDF upload + student X-Session-Token download). Frontend: critical flows verified via Playwright - landing loads, teacher login, dashboard shows 3 seeded exams with correct status badges, results page loads with student session cards, student join invalid/draft refused, FRA401 full flow (intro -> start -> answer MCQ + short -> Ctrl+V/Ctrl+C blocked and counted (violations 1/3) -> autosave 'Sauvegardé' indicator visible -> submit via modal confirm -> submitted-screen -> rejoin with same name shows 'Vous avez déjà remis cet examen'). All data-testid selectors wired correctly. require_fullscreen did not block headless Chromium in this environment (fullscreen-overlay not shown) which allowed full UI testing. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup updates admin password on each boot if env ADMIN_PASSWORD changes - good but if ADMIN_PASSWORD env drifts between deploys all teacher logins would reset silently; consider logging a warning.
logout cookie delete uses samesite='none' and secure=True but no domain param, which is consistent with set_auth_cookies - verify in prod.

COUNTED_EVENTS includes 'window_blur' - but requirement says blur ignored when desktop tools allowed; useAntiCheat should emit 'external_focus' (uncounted) in that case. Verified at runtime: when I triggered Ctrl+V and visibilitychange only 1 violation registered (shortcut), so client-side filtering is in place; backend trusts client type - if a malicious client sent window_blur it would still be counted. Minor hardening consideration.
/api/student/submit does not require status==in_progress; if locked, submit still transitions to submitted - may be intentional (students can submit after unlock) but worth confirming.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_* students and TEST_* exams during the run; TEST_ exams deleted after upload tests. TEST_ sessions remain under FRA401 for next run visibility.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_examsecure.py (22 tests, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Seeded codes FRA401 (open, max_violations=3), HIS301 (open redaction, max_violations=5), MAT402 (draft). TEST_ prefixed sessions have accumulated in FRA401; teacher dashboard flagged_count may increase. Fullscreen overlay was not triggered in headless Chromium so full exam UI was reachable without disabling require_fullscreen.
